hero.title: Expert Asset Valuation Solutions
hero.subtitle: Damno Valuation LLC provides property, business, collateral, and loss assessment services in compliance with Mongolian law and YOVC/IVS standards through a team of 35 specialists.

about.label: About Us
about.title: A valuation firm built on trust
about.description: Licensed by the Ministry of Finance on November 28, 2023 (No. 140600033, unlimited term), Damno Valuation delivers practical, evidence-based valuations with a three-stage quality control process and professional liability insurance from Practical Insurance LLC.

service.title: Residential Property Valuation
service.description: Valuation of apartments, houses, land, and buildings in Ulaanbaatar and provincial regions.

service.title: Movable Assets & Machinery
service.description: Professional valuation of vehicles, mining equipment, industrial lines, and other movable assets.

service.title: Business & Intangible Assets
service.description: Company valuation, shares, financial instruments, brands, licenses, patents, and intangible assets.

service.title: Bank Collateral Valuation
service.description: Collateral valuation accepted by Khan Bank, State Bank, Trade and Development Bank, and other lenders.

service.title: Loss Assessment & Legal Expertise
service.description: Asset loss assessment and expert reports for police, courts, customs, and tax authorities.

service.title: Land & Real Estate Valuation
service.description: Valuation of land, factories, offices, warehouses, retail spaces, and mining facilities.
